item_short_desc: Rothco’s Enhanced Molded Baton Holder is the perfect compact and easy-to-carry solution for law enforcement and public safety professionals. Designed for convenience and reliability, this baton holder features an open-top design, allowing for quick and easy access to your service baton when you need it most. description: Rothco’s Enhanced Molded Baton Holder is the perfect compact and easy-to-carry solution for law enforcement and public safety professionals. Designed for convenience and reliability, this baton holder features an open-top design, allowing for quick and easy access to your service baton when you need it most. Ideal for those on the job, this baton holder combines durability with practicality, ensuring you have quick access to your baton at all times.
